commit.message:
fix(post): comment text is escaped per dialect

The program header wrote the machine's name raw, so a name holding a
parenthesis (shipped: "Tormach 770MX (ML)", "PCNC 1100 (Series I)")
posted a nested comment that PathPilot refuses. Every post now runs the
header name through its #257 clean() like every other comment text;
Tormach's note() also leads a LinuxCNC active-comment keyword (MSG,
DEBUG, PRINT, LOG*, PROBEOPEN/CLOSE, ABORT, AXIS, PY) with "- "; the
PRELUDE's default writeComment drops parentheses and control chars.
Goldens are byte-identical. Pinned by tests/comment_escape.rs.

Fixes #594
